title: Wendy and the Doorway Tree
synopsis: Wendy visits the orchard for the first time, and the children invent Button Town through the ordinary two-trunk Doorway Tree.
continuity_state: Before: Doorway Tree named and map corrected; Wendy knows Far Meadow, Village Green and Reed Meadow but has never visited the orchard. After: Wendy visits the orchard with Aunt Kay; all agree Button Town is pretend, not a new physical settlement. Amy draws a small blue-circle paper visitor ticket and stores it inside her real yellow map; Wendy keeps her blue-ribboned hat.

related_resources.reason: The narrator distinguishes a concrete place from cooperative make-believe; the AAP report discusses pretend play but does not study this story.
Shared invented scenarios and objects are examples of imaginary play; Harvard discusses such activities for preschool children.
